The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control has intercepted 17 cartons of suspected unregistered beverages, skin-lightening injections and anti-ageing injections at the Mallam Aminu Kano International Airport, Kano State. NAFDAC disclosed this in a post on its X handle, seen by PUNCH Metro on Thursday. The agency said the seizure was made through its Port Inspection Directorate following a joint examination of a consignment at the Skyway Aviation Handling Company shed at the airport. According to NAFDAC, the products were discovered concealed in a 33-carton consignment declared as “personal effects” and brought into the country aboard an Ethiopian Airlines flight that arrived a day before the interception. “The products were discovered concealed within a 33-carton consignment declared as ‘personal effects’ and transported aboard an Ethiopian Airlines flight that arrived the previous day. NAFDAC, however, said the products had yet to be confirmed as substandard or falsified, adding that their quality and authenticity remained unknown. It stated that the interception was part of efforts to strengthen surveillance and enforcement at the nation’s entry points to prevent the unlawful importation and circulation of unregistered, substandard and falsified regulated products. “NAFDAC continues to strengthen surveillance and enforcement at Nigeria’s entry points to prevent the unlawful importation and circulation of unregistered, substandard and falsified regulated products and protect public health,” it added.
